primary_antecedent.receiving_contribution: Primary antecedent for the scalar normal commutator identity. The complete complex matrix normal coefficient, explicit ordered array, graph approximation and all actual boundary realizations are independently developed here. No verbatim book text or figure is reproduced.

source_correspondence: N0 fixes the full normalized differential operator with scalar real principal symbol, arbitrary complex lower matrices and actual H1 solution with L2 forcing. Both traces are the actual Sobolev and normal graph traces.

N1 proves inward smoothing in the two equation norms. One input integration controls the second-order coefficient commutator from H1 to L2; there is no input boundary term. Smooth density gives strong convergence, including both actual traces. The approximants are not claimed to satisfy the boundary condition.
N2 retains the normal derivative half-correction and proves the exact Green sign. Formal interior selfadjointness is not confused with selfadjointness on a boundary domain.

N3 derives the entire ordered matrix array and boundary form by separately integrating the second normal derivative and Hermitian tangential part, then retaining the anti-Hermitian and complex-normal contributions. No matrix factors are commuted.

N4 passes to the actual weak graph by continuity of every volume and boundary pairing. The weak normal trace has precisely the required order minus one half. The proof uses the L2 representative from BPL instead of pairing a natural-dual source with an inadmissible normal test.
N5 calculates the complete scalar Hamilton term and both anti-Hermitian matrix contributions. The complex normal coefficient contributes at principal quadratic order and cannot be discarded.

N6 substitutes the respective actual boundary condition. Dirichlet permits an exact negative square through a full lower-order operator adjustment; there is no discarded trace remainder. Neumann and Robin retain their signed forms and still require estimates.

N7 proves the complete localized equation, actual face jets and fixed-parameter H2 regularity. Normal independence at the face preserves both bare domains. The general Robin commutator remains, and uniform regularization estimates are not asserted.

N8 uses the earlier ordered matrix ODE theorem and retains every tangential derivative in the conjugated operator. Eliminating the first normal derivative changes bare Neumann to the explicitly stated Robin condition.

Three complete solutions verify the complex-normal contribution, the Neumann sign change and a noncommuting nilpotent gauge. Twenty-six algebra checks include a variable noncommuting matrix identity: total -85/3 equals boundary -16 plus volume -37/3.

Ten overlapping desktop captures, the complete figure and two mobile samples were inspected. The figure distinguishes unit value and unit normal traces and shows the exact changed boundary slope; all display extents are accessible.

Thirteen local entries bind to 1091 exact earlier entries in 60 maps, including 92 external Lebl proofs. Uniform propagation, the Neumann boundary estimate, the complementary Airy response and the full course remain unfinished. Internal export P514 closure is not claimed.
